meta.target_definitions: after subtracting the segment mean: V_rms = RMS, V_pp = max-min, |V|_max = max|v|; reproduce targets_design.parquet to max abs error listed in descriptor_check
meta.design: 5 specimens (one per composition) x 3 forces x 5 frequencies, one 1 s recording (1000 samples at 1 kHz) per condition; specimen and composition are confounded
meta.condition_id_note: condition_id = row index of data/targets_design.parquet (0-74) in every output

duplicates.method: Pearson r between every pair of recording-demeaned waveforms at lags -30..30 samples on the overlapping part, best |r| per pair; pairs with |r| >= 0.95 are listed with the least-squares scale copy = scale x original at the best lag and the relative residual ||copy - scale x original|| / ||copy||; the later condition id is called the copy; exact if residual < 1e-09

segmentation.method: fixed-period windows of one tap period, phase-aligned to the minimum of the folded mean-square profile; truncated edge windows kept only if they retain >= 0.95 of the folded energy
segmentation.period_rule: tap period = nominal 1/f unless the envelope-autocorrelation period folds the signal with a phase-lock concentration higher by >= 0.05; recordings whose chosen tap rate differs from the nominal label by more than 10% are listed as rate_deviates (data finding, not dropped)
segmentation.why_not_peak_detection: excursions are one-sample spikes of very unequal height; a height-thresholded peak detector (distance 0.8/f s, height >= 0.20 max|v|) finds fewer peaks than cycles at high f, dropping small cycles and biasing the CV downward; its count is kept as a cross-check
segmentation.flag_rule: segmentation_failed if phase-lock concentration at the chosen period < 0.60 or fewer than 3 cycles; failed and rate-deviating recordings stay in the primary summary and are excluded in sensitivity summaries
segmentation.rate_estimator: the deviation count n_rate_deviates uses the tap period chosen for segmentation: envelope-autocorrelation lag (smallest local maximum >= 0.8 of the largest, 30-260 samples) with the half-period check (accept P/2 if parity >= 0.60 and ACF(P/2)/ACF(P) >= 0.50), then kept only if it phase-locks at least 0.05 better than the nominal period; n_rate_deviates_spectral is an independent cross-check from the dominant frequency of the rectified signal spectrum in 3-30 Hz, which can land on a harmonic

rate_deviating_recordings.explained_by: scaled copy of condition 5, not a tapping effect

split_half.definition: half A = samples 0-499, half B = samples 500-999 of each 1 s recording; each descriptor recomputed after removing the half's own mean; LOO = within-grid leave-one-condition-out plain GP (legacy gp()), X standardized inside the fold; X_on_Y = trained by LOO on half X values, scored against half Y values

rms_Voc.noise_ceiling_assumption: full-recording noise variance = mean((A-B)^2)/4, exact for a mean of two halves, approximate for V_pp and |V|_max which are extremes over the two halves

Vpp.noise_ceiling_assumption: full-recording noise variance = mean((A-B)^2)/4, exact for a mean of two halves, approximate for V_pp and |V|_max which are extremes over the two halves

Vmax.noise_ceiling_assumption: full-recording noise variance = mean((A-B)^2)/4, exact for a mean of two halves, approximate for V_pp and |V|_max which are extremes over the two halves

anova_split_half.specification: three-factor factorial ANOVA, OLS on 2N rows (N conditions x 2 half-recordings), composition x force x frequency with all two-way interactions and the three-way interaction as a separate term; Type II SS by nested-model comparison with rank-based df (identical to anova_lm typ=2 for the balanced 75-condition design); the error term (df = 2N - rank) is the between-half variation inside each recording = acquisition repeatability, not pure error; partial eta^2 = SS/(SS+SS_error)

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap of R^2 computed on the fixed out-of-fold within-grid LOO predictions of the plain GP (no model refit), as in the legacy record-level bootstrap (regression/reg_stats.py boot_ci); record level resamples the N conditions, cluster level resamples the 5 specimens with replacement and takes all conditions of each drawn specimen; both use the same 2000 draws for every target, seed 0

held_out_specimen.definition: train on the conditions of four specimens, predict all conditions of the fifth (15 each for the full design); within-level R^2 and MAE use only the held-out conditions (their own mean in the R^2 denominator); pooled R^2 uses all out-of-fold predictions with the global mean (legacy)

duplicate_sensitivity.definition: headline results recomputed without recordings [52, 54, 73] (scaled copies, duplicated-recordings note in the README) with the same code paths as the primary analysis; equals the primary results of a --exclude-duplicates run

specDupAnovaOrderRmsExcl.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

specAnovaOrderRms.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

specDupAnovaOrderVppExcl.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

specAnovaOrderVpp.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

specDupAnovaOrderVmaxExcl.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

specAnovaOrderVmax.value: frequency, force, composition$\times$force, composition, three-way interaction, force$\times$frequency, composition$\times$frequency

index.results/a1_predictions.csv: out-of-fold plain GP predictions: loo (full), loo_halfA, loo_halfB, held_out_specimen
